sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/342 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 342, search/grid facility 397 'Buck Creek Campground' for 2027-06-15, 2026-12-15, 2027-01-12, 2027-02-16, 2027-03-16, search/details for all 107 web-listed campsites on 2027-06-15, plus one site of each type on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-06-19, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Non-electric sites $29 a night, electric $39, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) electric and full-hookup sites are $35, non-electric $25. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 107 Buck Creek campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 29.00, Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Fee 6.50; non-electric sites 'Maximum Camping Unit Length' 40); sites 001, 038, 102 on Sat 2027-06-19 (39.00 / 52.00 / 29.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00 / 35.00 / 25.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '20/30/50' on 60 campsites, '30' on 26; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on 40 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/buck-creek-state-park-campground ('44 Full-hookup sites with extended pads', '86 Electric sites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: ReserveOhio lists 107 web-bookable campsites (41 full hookup, 45 electric, 21 non-electric), all back-in; full-hookup pads take 60 ft, most electric sites 31 ft, non-electric 40 ft. ODNR's campground page counts 44 full-hookup, 86 electric and 21 non-electric sites (151) and ReserveOhio's park text says 110. Pets are permitted on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid facility 397 (107 units, AllowWebBooking on all) + search/details (UnitType, PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 60/40/31) + search/place ('Buck Creek offers 110 campsites') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/buck-creek-state-park-campground ('44 Full-hookup sites', '86 Electric sites', '21 Non-electric sites', 'Pets are permitted on all sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Small unguarded beach for registered campers only; seasonal camp store (firewood, ice, snacks, pedal-kart rentals).

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/buck-creek-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, and dump station'; 'Small unguarded beach is available for registered campers only'; 'Open seasonally, the Camp Store (937-327-4590) offers firewood, ice, snacks, and pedal kart rentals') + ReserveOhio search/details ('Distance to Drinking Water' per site), read 2026-10-30

values.note: ReserveOhio sells electric and full-hookup sites through the winter (86 of 107 bookable December-March); the 21 non-electric sites are blocked off-season.

season.source: ReserveOhio search/grid facility 397 for 2026-12-15, 2027-01-12, 2027-02-16, 2027-03-16 (86 units free, 21 blocked) + search/details rates for 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations required, online or at (866) 644-6727; campsites 6 months ahead. Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/buck-creek-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and can be made online or by calling (866) 644-6727.'; 'Campsite reservations can be made 6 months in advance.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($29 non-electric base, +$10 electric, +$23 full hookup) and added the $25/$35 off-peak rates. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at the full-hookup sites, 107 web-bookable back-in sites to 60 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump/camp store, year-round season (non-electric blocked in winter), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. ODNR counts 151 sites vs ReserveOhio's 107. Pin 251 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated for this park: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (937) 327-4590 (the campground's camp store line); the park office is (937) 322-5284, 8-4:30 weekdays.
Pin 251 m west of the centroid of ReserveOhio's 107 campsite coordinates (inside the campground's spread, 20 m from the nearest site). Centroid: 39.96911,-83.72746 if a central pin is wanted.

Site count disagreement: ODNR's campground page lists 44 full-hookup + 86 electric (50-amp) + 21 non-electric = 151 sites; ReserveOhio lists 107 web-bookable campsites (41 FH, 45 electric of which 25 are 30-amp only, 21 non-electric) and its park text says 110. Recorded 107.
